title: Concept: Queue URL and account path in a response
description: An SQS queue URL that embeds the account id and queue name in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The URL names the queue that carries transfer or notification events, and a policy mistake on that queue becomes directly reachable once the name is known.
applicability: Deployments that render an SQS queue URL that embeds the account id and queue name into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The URL names the queue that carries transfer or notification events, and a policy mistake on that queue becomes directly reachable once the name is known.
